match.subject: promo_code
match.key: Task 1: purchase dispute: promo code out of date.

args.question: Is the customer's promo code out of date claim a company error?

guards.why: policies/membership: level may get a new code and system confirms company error

reply:
Hi {{s.pull_up_account.account.name|first}}!

Thanks for flagging this. I looked into the promo code on your account — our promotions only run for 7 days from the date they're issued, so the code you were trying had passed its expiration window.

Good news: I've issued you a new one. Your replacement code is **{{s.promo_code.code}}** for {{s.promo_code.percent}}% off, valid through {{s.promo_code.expires}}. Just enter it at checkout and the discount will apply to your order.

Sorry for the hassle! Is there anything else I can help you with?
